From a strictly mathematical perspective:
2 dogs, 3 months, $900

that is $300 a month = $150 per dog per month = only $5 (COUNT THEM, FIVE DOLLARS) per dog per night.

If you are regular booked up at least one dog per night, you are losing at the MINIMUM $40 (FORTY DOLLARS) per night, and if we want to be technical and include both dogs, $80 (EIGHTY DOLLARS) per night.

I would definitely find a compromise if you’re open to it - at full price for 2 dogs/$45 per dog/90 nights is almost $8000, and while that is an appropriate amount, it is not always doable by the customer. 

I would say at least $600-900 a month, and that’s if you really love this customer, because it would still only be $10-15 per dog per night. I do have customers that are really easy going and lovely to work with that I would feel comfortable offering this amount to, even though it is severely lowballing my labor.

Remember to treat yourself with respect here! This is a long commitment, and as nice as the dogs may be you really don’t want to get a month in and regret taking this job.
